pr_title: [ML] Fix startOffset must be non-negative error in XLMRoBERTa tokenizer
pr_body:
As reported in #104626 tokenizing certain texts with the XLMRoBERTa tokenizer can throw this error

```
startOffset must be non-negative, and endOffset must be >= startOffset; 
```

The error is caused when the normalisation step produces text that is longer than the input text and an offset needs to be added to map back to the original. Tests have been added to cover these bad cases using a subset of the tokenizer's vocabulary.

closes #104626
pr_comments: Hi @davidkyle, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

Thanks for the review, the notification got lost sorry hence the delay.

I've moved the test vocab into a resource file and fix the logic calculating the offset.
